profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at BAE Systems
profile.summary:
A results-driven senior level Software Developer with demonstrated success in the architecture, design, development and deployment of large-scale enterprise applications. 

Over 15 years proven experience developing enterprise-class business solutions utilizing service oriented, distributed systems architectures leveraging Enterprise Java, microservice and SOA architectures. Dedicated senior level professional with demonstrated effectiveness in object-oriented analysis and design and systems architecture. Proven ability to leverage agile methodologies in order to produce robust, reusable, and maintainable software systems on schedule. Proven ability to mentor junior developers and ensure governance of design and coding standards.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Design, develop, and deliver mission critical geospatial intelligence applications for the Departments of Defense and Homeland Security.  Employ a host of Java EE, SpringSource, AngularJS, and related technologies to produce a wide array of integrated applications for the purposes of geospatial exploitation in a high traffic production environment.  Utilize RESTful  and service oriented design methodologies to produce robust and scalable software components.  Mentor development staff and provide architectural guidance to management.  Key evaluator of new technologies for insertion into projects.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implemented SOA solutions in an n-tiered, heterogeneous enterprise environment for the mortgage banking industry.  Developed components/applications using both the Java EE and .NET platforms.  Utilized OOAD in order to build robust, effective, and maintainable solutions.  Worked with business stakeholders to evaluate requirements and propose solutions.  Ensured on time delivery of projects to the production environment.  Mentored and trained l development staff.

positions.title: Senior Internal Audit and Quality Control Analyst
positions.description:
Supervised and shaped a dynamic Internal Audit and Quality Control Department, audited financial products and personnel,
implemented a nationwide employee training program, developed a departmental resource intranet site, and forecasted
future production.

positions.title: Senior Loan Processing Manager
positions.description:
Managed all aspects of loan production from origination through post closing, held liaison with secondary market investors,
and ensured profitable loan transactions.

honors.title: BAE System's Chairman's Award
honors.description: Part of a research and development team that provided innovative research in the area of knowledge management and semantic discovery of data sourced from structured and unstructured repositories.  Entities were extracted, relationships discovered and visualized to the user via a knowledge-based U.I.
